
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20062360" title="发布于 2026-05-17 07:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">17. LangChain FewShotPromptTemplate少样本应用实战</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>做 AI 应用开发的人应该都有过这种经历：明明在提示词里写了一大堆要求，大模型还是会输出不符合预期的内容，甚至一本正经地胡说八道。这时候，与其继续堆砌文字说明，不如试试 LangChain 里的 FewShotPromptTemplate—— 用几个简单的示例，就能让大模型瞬间明白你想要什么。视频在这里<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1XSLu69Et6/" rel="noopener nofollow">《17. LangChain FewShotPromptTemplate 少样本应用实战》</a>。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260517072432785-1520797883.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;这个工具的底层逻辑是少样本学习，说白了就是让<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="大模型" data-pretit="大模型">大模型先看几个正确的示范，再去处理新的任务。不管是翻译、文本分类还是逻辑推理，只要给对了例子，它的输出准确率和一致性都会有明显提升。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202605/1919157-20260517072447590-1529765820.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;它的核心思想特别朴素：与其给 AI 写几百字的任务说明，不如直接扔给它两三个具体的例子。大模型对示例的理解能力，远比我们想象的要强得多。</p>
<p>这里有个容易踩的坑：创建 FewShotPromptTemplate 的时候，examples 和 example_selector 这两个参数是互斥的，必须填其中一个，不然代码直接报错。绝大多数情况下，我们直接用 examples 参数把准备好的示例数据传进去就行。</p>
<table style="height: 468px; width: 1007px" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>组件</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>说明</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>必填性</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>示例</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>example_selector</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>动态选择示例的选择器</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>二选一</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>SemanticSimilarityExampleSelector</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>examples</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>示例数据列表，每个是字典</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>二选一</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>[{"input": "Hi", "output": "你好"}]</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>example_prompt</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>单个示例的格式化模板</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>必填</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>PromptTemplate.from_template(...)</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>prefix</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>示例前的引导文本</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>可选，默认""</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>"请把英文翻译成中文："</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>suffix</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>示例后的用户输入提示</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>必填</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>"Input: {new_input}\nOutput:"</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>input_variables</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>用户输入变量列表</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>必填</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>["new_input"]</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="151">
<p>example_separator</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="142">
<p>示例之间的分隔符</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="104">
<p>默认\n\n</p>
</td>
<td valign="top" width="156">
<p>"\n"</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>先来看最基础的用法，针对文本补全模型，我们可以这样写：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PromptTemplate, FewShotPromptTemplate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备示例数据</span>
examples =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Thank you</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">谢谢</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Good morning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">早上好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义示例的格式化模板</span>
example_prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PromptTemplate.from_template(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{input} -&gt; {output}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建 FewShotPromptTemplate</span>
few_shot_prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FewShotPromptTemplate(
    examples</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">examples,
    example_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">example_prompt,
    prefix</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请把以下英文翻译成中文：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    suffix</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input} -&gt; </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    input_variables</span>=[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    example_separator</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
)
prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> few_shot_prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Good bye</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(prompt_value.to_string())
res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(res.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>如果用的是聊天模型，就要用专门的 FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate，用法也差不多：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate, FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备示例数据</span>
examples =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Thank you</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">谢谢</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
    {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Good morning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">早上好</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义示例的格式化模板</span>
example_prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{output}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建示例提示词模版</span>
few_shot_prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FewShotChatMessagePromptTemplate(
    examples</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">examples,
    example_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">example_prompt
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构建最终的聊天提示模板</span>
chat_prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请把以下英文翻译成中文：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        few_shot_prompt,
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输入内容</span>
prompt_value =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chat_prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Where are you from?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    }
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(prompt_value.to_string())
res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(res.content)</pre>
</div>
<p>总的来说，FewShotPromptTemplate 是解决大模型输出不稳定问题最简单也最有效的手段之一。不用改模型，不用调参数，只要花几分钟准备几个高质量的示例，就能让你的 AI 应用体验上一个台阶。</p>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
